programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: After visiting a beekeeper, Michel is inspired to use honey as part of a delicious duck dish. Later, he tries to impress his wife with a fruit compote.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater creates a week's worth of simple but delicious meals from ingredients that are often overlooked. He effortlessly prepares a sumptuous beetroot cake, a lentil and chard stew and a beef and ale casserole, before travelling to Derbyshire to help keen gardeners Ian and Kathy create tasty food from their plot.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Mouth-watering chocolate cookies and crispy duck with honey and figs prove that a little bit of what you fancy does you good. Then to balance the scales, Nigel makes a couple of dishes full of clean-tasting flavours, with fresh herbs, tomatoes and crunchy greens - but whether saints or sinners, every dish will taste truly divine.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's digging into appetisers, dessert and everything in-between. In Laramie, WY, an old-school cafe is loadin' up green-chili burritos and scratch-made pie. A spot in Anchorage, AK, is going next level with their blackened chicken gnocchi.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of funky flavour, starting in Laramie, WY, where a restaurant-bar is pilin' up their nachos, and a longtime spot is cooking up a vegetarian banh mi. Then, a Mexican joint in Alaska is serving dynamite duck tacos.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's diving into Asian flavours alongside a taste of Italy, starting at a Vietnamese spot in Albuquerque, NM, that's servin' up out-of-bounds banh mi. Plus, in Anchorage, AK, a real deal Italian deli is adding magic to their sandwiches.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's diggin' into dishes perfect for pickin' up and chowin' down, like a bomb barbecue pie at a pizza-bakery in Laramie, WY. Then, a funky Cleveland bar is making monster tots, and a Vietnamese spot in Anchorage, AK, is cookin' up crepes.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: The owner of a Las Vegas bistro fears his restaurant manager, who happens to be his brother, is not doing a good job, so the Mystery Diners check up on him.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: A pub owner in Los Angeles uses undercover surveillance to spy on one of her employees, who she suspects is over-pouring for customers, giving away too many free drinks and over-tipping himself.
